description: Higher-Order Lattice Combinators (Cartesian Closed Category morphisms) for modular, language-agnostic control flow synthesis in NSTL.

cells.doc: Lambda Abstraction / Morphism Definition: Encapsulates a parameterized sub-pipeline into a named, reusable Callable function with explicit signature and scope.
cells.docstring: Lambda Abstraction / Morphism Definition: Encapsulates a parameterized sub-pipeline into a named, reusable Callable function with explicit signature and scope.

cells.doc: Anonymous Curried Morphism: Constructs an inline anonymous lambda closure mapping bound arguments to an expression.
cells.docstring: Anonymous Curried Morphism: Constructs an inline anonymous lambda closure mapping bound arguments to an expression.

cells.doc: Object Coalgebra Encapsulation: Defines a class state machine bundling internal typestate fields and member method morphisms.
cells.docstring: Object Coalgebra Encapsulation: Defines a class state machine bundling internal typestate fields and member method morphisms.

cells.doc: Structural Recursion (Fixpoint Operator): Defines a self-referential recursive morphism with base predicate, base action, and inductive recursive step.
cells.docstring: Structural Recursion (Fixpoint Operator): Defines a self-referential recursive morphism with base predicate, base action, and inductive recursive step.

cells.doc: Branching Divide-and-Conquer Recursion: Recursively partitions a problem into subproblems, evaluates them recursively, and combines results (e.g. MergeSort, QuadTree, Tree Traversal).
cells.docstring: Branching Divide-and-Conquer Recursion: Recursively partitions a problem into subproblems, evaluates them recursively, and combines results (e.g. MergeSort, QuadTree, Tree Traversal).

cells.doc: Arbitrary N-Ary Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif ... / elif / else): Evaluates an ordered list of (predicate, action) pairs sequentially until one matches, falling back to default.
cells.docstring: Arbitrary N-Ary Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif ... / elif / else): Evaluates an ordered list of (predicate, action) pairs sequentially until one matches, falling back to default.

cells.doc: Hierarchical 2D Nested Iteration: Evaluates a loop inside a loop across outer and inner collections, threading an accumulated state forward across all coordinate points.
cells.docstring: Hierarchical 2D Nested Iteration: Evaluates a loop inside a loop across outer and inner collections, threading an accumulated state forward across all coordinate points.

cells.doc: Ranked slice morphism: Sorts a collection in descending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the top K elements (e.g. largest K contours).

code_templates.cpp:
std::vector<{T}> {output_collection};
std::partial_sort_copy({collection}.begin(), {collection}.end(), std::back_inserter({output_collection}), {k}, [](const {T}& a, const {T}& b) { return {key_fn}(a) > {key_fn}(b); });

cells.docstring: Ranked slice morphism: Sorts a collection in descending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the top K elements (e.g. largest K contours).

cells.doc: Ranked bottom slice morphism: Sorts a collection in ascending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the smallest K elements.

code_templates.cpp:
std::vector<{T}> {output_collection};
std::partial_sort_copy({collection}.begin(), {collection}.end(), std::back_inserter({output_collection}), {k}, [](const {T}& a, const {T}& b) { return {key_fn}(a) < {key_fn}(b); });

cells.docstring: Ranked bottom slice morphism: Sorts a collection in ascending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the smallest K elements.

cells.doc: Element-wise Functor morphism: Applies a unary transformation to every element of a collection [T] -> [U].
cells.docstring: Element-wise Functor morphism: Applies a unary transformation to every element of a collection [T] -> [U].

cells.doc: Predicate Selection Sub-collection morphism: Filters elements of a collection matching a boolean predicate function.
cells.docstring: Predicate Selection Sub-collection morphism: Filters elements of a collection matching a boolean predicate function.

cells.doc: Monadic Bind morphism: Maps each element to a collection and flattens the resulting collections into a single one-dimensional list.

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [elem for sublist in ({transform}(item) for item in {collection}) for elem in sublist]

cells.docstring: Monadic Bind morphism: Maps each element to a collection and flattens the resulting collections into a single one-dimensional list.

cells.doc: Catamorphism / Accumulator morphism: Iteratively applies a binary associative operator over a collection, folding it into a single accumulated State value.
cells.docstring: Catamorphism / Accumulator morphism: Iteratively applies a binary associative operator over a collection, folding it into a single accumulated State value.

cells.doc: Applicative Zipper morphism: Pairs elements from two lists, applying a binary zipper function to produce a unified list.

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [{zipper}(a, b) for a, b in zip({collection_a}, {collection_b})]

cells.docstring: Applicative Zipper morphism: Pairs elements from two lists, applying a binary zipper function to produce a unified list.

cells.doc: Iterative State-Threading Loop: Sequentially iterates through a collection, feeding each element and threading the accumulated State forward.
cells.docstring: Iterative State-Threading Loop: Sequentially iterates through a collection, feeding each element and threading the accumulated State forward.

cells.doc: Bounded Index Range Loop: Executes a counted loop over [start, stop) with step, threading state through each iteration.
cells.docstring: Bounded Index Range Loop: Executes a counted loop over [start, stop) with step, threading state through each iteration.

cells.doc: Indexed Enumeration Map: Transforms each element alongside its integer index (idx, item) into an updated collection.

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [{transform}(idx, item) for idx, item in enumerate({collection}, start={start_index})]
code_templates.rust: let {output_collection}: Vec<{U}> = {collection}.iter().enumerate().map(|(idx, item)| {transform}((idx as i64 + {start_index}) as i32, item)).collect();

cells.docstring: Indexed Enumeration Map: Transforms each element alongside its integer index (idx, item) into an updated collection.

cells.doc: Inductive Fixpoint Monad: Continuously computes State -> State as long as cond_fn(State) remains true.
cells.docstring: Inductive Fixpoint Monad: Continuously computes State -> State as long as cond_fn(State) remains true.

cells.doc: Safe Bounded Fixpoint Loop: Evaluates State -> State while cond_fn(State) is true, with a strict max_iters bound to guarantee termination.
cells.docstring: Safe Bounded Fixpoint Loop: Evaluates State -> State while cond_fn(State) is true, with a strict max_iters bound to guarantee termination.

cells.doc: Post-Condition Inductive Loop (do-while): Executes body_fn at least once, repeating until until_cond_fn(State) is true.
cells.docstring: Post-Condition Inductive Loop (do-while): Executes body_fn at least once, repeating until until_cond_fn(State) is true.

cells.doc: Coproduct / Sum Eliminator: Dispatches computation to either on_true or on_false based on a boolean condition flag.
cells.docstring: Coproduct / Sum Eliminator: Dispatches computation to either on_true or on_false based on a boolean condition flag.

cells.doc: Chained Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif / else): Evaluates primary and secondary boolean conditions sequentially to dispatch the corresponding operator.
cells.docstring: Chained Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif / else): Evaluates primary and secondary boolean conditions sequentially to dispatch the corresponding operator.

cells.doc: Structural Pattern Matching / Switch: Dispatches against discrete discriminator values with a wildcard default fallback.

code_templates.python:
match {discriminator}:
    case _val if _val == {case_a_val}:
        {result} = {action_a}({data})
    case _val if _val == {case_b_val}:
        {result} = {action_b}({data})
    case _:
        {result} = {default_action}({data})

cells.docstring: Structural Pattern Matching / Switch: Dispatches against discrete discriminator values with a wildcard default fallback.

cells.doc: Error Trap / Either Monad morphism: Safely evaluates an action, catching specific runtime exceptions and executing a fallback handler.
cells.docstring: Error Trap / Either Monad morphism: Safely evaluates an action, catching specific runtime exceptions and executing a fallback handler.

cells.doc: Guaranteed Cleanup Trap: Wraps action execution with exception recovery and a guaranteed finalizer hook executed under all conditions.
cells.docstring: Guaranteed Cleanup Trap: Wraps action execution with exception recovery and a guaranteed finalizer hook executed under all conditions.

cells.doc: Branching Error Guard: Executes success_continuation solely if action completes with no exceptions; otherwise triggers fallback.
cells.docstring: Branching Error Guard: Executes success_continuation solely if action completes with no exceptions; otherwise triggers fallback.

cells.doc: Resilience Retry Loop: Repeatedly attempts an action up to max_retries with exponential delay, falling back if all attempts fail.
cells.docstring: Resilience Retry Loop: Repeatedly attempts an action up to max_retries with exponential delay, falling back if all attempts fail.

cells.doc: Short-Circuit Search: Traverses a collection and returns the first element satisfying a predicate, or default_val if no match is found.
cells.docstring: Short-Circuit Search: Traverses a collection and returns the first element satisfying a predicate, or default_val if no match is found.

cells.doc: Universal Quantifier: Checks whether all elements of a collection satisfy a boolean predicate.
cells.docstring: Universal Quantifier: Checks whether all elements of a collection satisfy a boolean predicate.

cells.doc: Existential Quantifier: Checks whether at least one element of a collection satisfies a boolean predicate.
cells.docstring: Existential Quantifier: Checks whether at least one element of a collection satisfies a boolean predicate.

cells.doc: Predicate Partition Morphism: Divides a collection into two complementary sub-collections: (satisfied, unsatisfied).

code_templates.python: {true_collection}, {false_collection} = ([x for x in {collection} if {predicate}(x)], [x for x in {collection} if not {predicate}(x)])

cells.docstring: Predicate Partition Morphism: Divides a collection into two complementary sub-collections: (satisfied, unsatisfied).

cells.doc: Precondition Guard Clause: Asserts a boolean condition holds; if false, immediately yields fallback_val without evaluating action.
cells.docstring: Precondition Guard Clause: Asserts a boolean condition holds; if false, immediately yields fallback_val without evaluating action.

cells.doc: Bracket / RAII Context Manager: Acquires a managed resource, securely runs body_fn within the active context, and guarantees deterministic release.
cells.docstring: Bracket / RAII Context Manager: Acquires a managed resource, securely runs body_fn within the active context, and guarantees deterministic release.
